commits.subject: fix(copilot): report exhausted trade event queries

release_notes.text: Added a fast loopback-bind permission probe to full release preflight, giving an immediate non-sandbox rerun instruction while retaining the HTTP and model-path tests.

Reported when a bounded Copilot trade-event query has reached the end of its current result set, so larger follow-up requests explain that a new query is required instead of failing evidence admission.
